# HouseClear

> HouseClear is a professional house clearance company covering Cheshire, Flintshire, Denbighshire, Liverpool, Wrexham and the Wirral (UK). Registered waste carrier, fully insured. Every clearance includes a digital waste transfer note and VAT invoice. Reusable items are donated, resold or recycled before disposal. Fixed quotes from photos, usually the same day. Phone: 01244 722 330 (Chester) or 0151 440 3704 (Liverpool). Website: https://houseclear.uk/

Key facts:
- Services: full and partial house clearance, probate and bereavement clearance, hoarder clearance, garage, loft and flat clearance, end of tenancy clearance
- Clients: homeowners, landlords, letting and estate agents, solicitors, executors, housing providers
- Compliance: Environment Agency registered waste carrier (England & Wales), public liability insured, digital waste transfer notes, VAT invoices; finance available on larger clearances
- Coverage: Chester, Ellesmere Port, Northwich, Mold, Buckley, Deeside, Wrexham, Rhyl, Prestatyn, Denbigh, Ruthin, Liverpool, Birkenhead, Wallasey, Heswall, West Kirby and surrounding areas
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ENYvPdr3JCx8Pux27
- Legal entity: HouseClear is a trading name of Tidy Up Ltd (Company No. 14294404, registered office Hawarden, Deeside CH5 3NU); Environment Agency waste carrier registration CBDU464597

## Services
- [House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/house-clearance/): Full and part house clearances carried out by a respectful, fully insured local team — with responsible disposal and the paperwork to prove it.
- [Probate House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/probate-house-clearance/): A careful, fully documented clearance service for executors, families and solicitors managing an estate.
- [Bereavement House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/bereavement-house-clearance/): Clearing a loved one's home is never easy. Our team works patiently, discreetly and entirely at your pace.
- [Partial House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/partial-house-clearance/): Just need certain rooms or items cleared? We remove exactly what you want gone — nothing more.
- [Full House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/full-house-clearance/): Every room emptied — loft to garden — and the property left swept, tidy and ready for what comes next.
- [Hoarder House Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/hoarder-house-clearance/): A discreet, non-judgemental team experienced in clearing heavily cluttered and hoarded properties.
- [Garage Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/garage-clearance/): Years of accumulated tools, timber, paint tins and forgotten boxes — cleared in a couple of hours.
- [Loft Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/loft-clearance/): We do the climbing, the carrying and the sorting — your loft emptied safely without you lifting a thing.
- [Flat Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/flat-clearance/): Upper floors, narrow staircases, communal entrances and permit parking — flats are our everyday work.
- [End of Tenancy Clearance](https://houseclear.uk/services/end-of-tenancy-clearance/): Fast turnarounds for landlords, letting agents and tenants — with the waste paperwork your records need.

## Guides
- [What is a waste transfer note?](https://houseclear.uk/guides/what-is-a-waste-transfer-note/): A waste transfer note is your legal proof that household waste went to a licensed carrier. What it must include, how long to keep it, and why it protects you.
- [How to check a waste carrier licence](https://houseclear.uk/guides/how-to-check-a-waste-carrier-licence/): Before anyone removes waste from your property, check their registration on the public waste carrier register. Here's exactly how, in under a minute.
- [Clearing a house during probate: a guide for executors](https://houseclear.uk/guides/clearing-a-house-during-probate/): When can you clear a house during probate? A practical guide for executors — timing, valuables, estate paperwork and managing it all from a distance.
- [What happens to belongings after a house clearance?](https://houseclear.uk/guides/what-happens-to-belongings-after-a-house-clearance/): Where do the contents of a cleared house go? How reputable firms sort donation, resale, recycling and disposal — and why it matters to families.
- [How much does a house clearance cost?](https://houseclear.uk/guides/how-much-does-a-house-clearance-cost/): House clearance pricing explained: how volume-based quotes work, what moves the price up or down, and how contents value can reduce your bill.
- [House clearance vs skip hire: an honest comparison](https://houseclear.uk/guides/house-clearance-vs-skip-hire/): Skip hire or a clearance company? An honest comparison of cost, effort, permits, recycling and legal responsibility — and when a skip genuinely wins.
- [House clearance checklist for executors](https://houseclear.uk/guides/house-clearance-checklist-for-executors/): A step-by-step checklist for executors arranging a house clearance — before, during and after, from valuables and paperwork to the waste transfer note.
